content.title: Laundry Task Reset | Inventory Completion and Window Pause
content.summary: An archive conservator cleans and returns five linen covers before a window pause. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One adult, one bounded task and one inventory remain continuous. + Each task action visibly changes the inventory state. + Completion is proven before the character leaves the machine area. + The open-view pause follows completion rather than interrupting it. + The final return places the completed inventory at its intended destination.
quick_start.recommended_input: Follow one adult conservator gathering five linen covers from an archive workroom into one blue cart. Retrieve the same covers into the blue cart after the indicator reaches complete. Pause for one breath beside the open view, then return the complete folded stack to the original shelf bay.

invariants.rule: One adult, one bounded task and one inventory remain continuous.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One adult, one bounded task and one inventory remain continuous."

invariants.rule: Each task action visibly changes the inventory state.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Each task action visibly changes the inventory state."

invariants.rule: Completion is proven before the character leaves the machine area.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Completion is proven before the character leaves the machine area."

invariants.rule: The open-view pause follows completion rather than interrupting it.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "The open-view pause follows completion rather than interrupting it."

invariants.rule: The final return places the completed inventory at its intended destination.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The final return places the completed inventory at its intended destination."
